description: This line plot illustrates the accuracy percentage across varying numbers of video frames for four different methods. The x-axis represents the “Number of Frames,” ranging from 10 to 60 with tick marks at intervals of 10, and is labeled in linear scale. The y-axis represents “Accuracy (%)”, ranging from 40 to 54, also on a linear scale. The blue line with circular markers, labeled “Ours (Dynamic Seg)”, starts at approximately 53% at 10 frames, rises slightly to about 54% at 20 frames, and then remains nearly flat at around 53.5% through 60 frames. The green line with circular markers, labeled “Ours (Static 4-Seg)”, begins at approximately 52.5% at 10 frames, rises to about 53.5% at 20 frames, and then stays nearly constant at approximately 53.5% through 60 frames. The orange line with square markers, labeled “Ours (Static 4-Seg)”, starts at approximately 45% at 10 frames, decreases to about 42.5% at 30 frames, and continues declining to approximately 39.5% at 60 frames. The red line with square markers, labeled “PLLaVA (DP 16)”, begins at approximately 45.5% at 10 frames, declines steadily to about 42.5% at 30 frames, and continues decreasing to approximately 42% at 60 frames.
